editedSummaries.body: Re-reviewed after the rebase: the conflict resolution looks mostly right, one nit left.

instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing.
Read every item marked `[edited since first look]`, including edited summaries and edited first-look bullets, before deciding whether to resolve a matching thread.
Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal: resolve the conflicts, commit, push to the PR head branch, then iterate immediately with the same options.
